CLSActivity.doc: A representation of user interaction with a context.

CLSActivityItem.doc: An abstract base class for gathering information about an activity.

CLSBinaryItem.doc: Activity information that is true or false, pass or fail, yes or no.

CLSContext.doc: An area of your app that represents an assignable task, like a quiz or a chapter.

CLSDataStore.doc: A container for all the ClassKit data in your app.

CLSObject.doc: The abstract base class for objects managed by ClassKit.

CLSProgressReportingCapability.doc: A progress reporting capability supported by a context.

CLSQuantityItem.doc: Activity information that signifies a quantity.

CLSScoreItem.doc: Activity information that signifies a score out of a possible maximum.

CLSContextProvider.doc: An interface used to tell your ClassKit context provider app extension to update contexts.

CLSDataStoreDelegate.doc: An interface the data store uses to request new contexts.

CLSBinaryValueType.doc: The kinds of outcomes that a binary activity item can represent.

CLSContextType.doc: The kinds of assignable content a context can contain.

CLSContextTypeCourse.doc: A context that represents an entire course.

CLSContextTypeCustom.doc: A context for assignable content that isn’t represented by one of the built-in context types.

CLSProgressReportingCapabilityKind.doc: The available kinds of progress reporting that a context can perform.

-addAdditionalActivityItem:.doc: Adds an activity item to an activity.

-addProgressRangeFromStart:toEnd:.doc: Adds a progress range to a given activity.

-removeAllActivityItems.doc: Deletes all activity items associated with the current activity.

-start.doc: Tells an activity to start recording duration and progress for a task.

-stop.doc: Tells an activity to stop or pause recording duration and progress for a task.

-initWithIdentifier:title:type:.doc: Initializes a new binary activity item of the given type.

-addChildContext:.doc: Adds the specifed context as a child of the context receiving the method call.

-addNavigationChildContext:.doc: Adds a child context that users can navigate to from this context.

-addProgressReportingCapabilities:.doc: Adds a progress reporting capability to the set of capabilities for the context.

-becomeActive.doc: Tells a context to become the active context.

-createNewActivity.doc: Creates and returns a new activity instance for the context.

-descendantMatchingIdentifierPath:comple.doc: Finds the context with the given identifier path relative to this context.

-removeFromParent.doc: Removes the context from its parent.

-removeNavigationChildContext:.doc: Removes the specified context as a presentable child of this context.

-resetProgressReportingCapabilities.doc: Resets the set of capabilities for the context.

-resignActive.doc: Tells a context to stop being the active context.

-setType:.doc: Updates the kind of content that a context represents.

-completeAllAssignedActivitiesMatching:.doc: Marks all of the assigned and active activities for the given context path as complete.

-contextsMatchingIdentifierPath:completi.doc: Fetches all the contexts along a given identifier path.

-contextsMatchingPredicate:completion:.doc: Fetches all the contexts matching a predicate.

-fetchActivityForURL:completion:.doc: Fetches an activity for a given document so you can record progress on the associated task.

-saveWithCompletion:.doc: Saves any changes you’ve made in the data store.

-initWithKind:details:.doc: Creates a new progress reporting capability of the given type with a descriptive string.

-initWithIdentifier:title:.doc: Initializes an activity item that records a discrete quantity.

-initWithIdentifier:title:score:maxScore.doc: Initializes an activity item that holds a score value.

additionalActivityItems.doc: The list of activity items associated with an activity.

duration.doc: The cumulative time in seconds that an activity has been active.

primaryActivityItem.doc: Adds an activity item to an activity and sets it as the primary activity item.

progress.doc: A measure of progress through the task, given as a fraction in the range [0, 1].

started.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether an activity is running.

identifier.doc: An identifier for the activity item.

title.doc: A human readable name for the activity item.

value.doc: The value that the binary activity item takes.

valueType.doc: The kind of outcome that the binary activity item represents.

active.doc: A Boolean indicating whether the context is active.

assignable.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether teachers can assign the context as a task.

currentActivity.doc: The activity available for recording progress.

customTypeName.doc: An optional name that the system presents to the user if you choose the custom context type.

displayOrder.doc: The position of a context relative to its siblings.

identifier.doc: A string that uniquely identifies a context among its siblings.

identifierPath.doc: The identifier path that locates the context within the data store’s context hierarchy.

navigationChildContexts.doc: The child contexts that a user can navigate to from this context in the Schoolwork app.

parent.doc: The direct ancestor of this context.

progressReportingCapabilities.doc: The kinds of progress reporting that the context can perform.

suggestedAge.doc: The range of ages, measured in years, for which you deem a context’s content suitable.

suggestedCompletionTime.doc: A suggested time range to complete a task, measured in minutes.

summary.doc: An optional, user-visible description of the context.

thumbnail.doc: An optional thumbnail image associated with the context.

title.doc: The name of the context as it appears to users.

topic.doc: The area of study to which a context relates.

type.doc: The kind of content a context represents.

universalLinkURL.doc: A URL that leads to the content in your app associated with the current context.

runningActivity.doc: The currently running activity within the currently active context.

dateCreated.doc: The date on which the object was created.

dateLastModified.doc: The date on which the object was last modified.

CLSProgressReportingCapabilityKind.doc: The available kinds of progress reporting that a context can perform.

details.doc: A description of the capability presented to teachers.

kind.doc: The kind of progress reporting capability.

quantity.doc: A quantity associated with the task.

maxScore.doc: The maximum possible score that the user can earn on a given task.

score.doc: The score earned by a user in completing the task.
